7.title: MAI — Eagles
7.content: The Orlando Eagles are a Division of Missionary Athletes International (MAI). MAI was founded in 1983 with a mission of glorifying God and seeing lives transformed by sharing the message of Jesus Christ through the global environment of soccer. Today, MAI has 6 Divisions in the United States, located in: Orlando, Florida, Southern California; Charlotte, North Carolina; High Point, North Carolina, Chicago, Illinois, and Phoenix, Arizona with additional ministry affiliate programs occurring in other states and countries around the world.

8.title: Mission — Eagles
8.content:
Our Mission

  Orlando Eagles is a division of MAI which is a gospel-centered ministry that introduces people to Jesus Christ, teaches them to follow Him, and empowers them as leaders through the global environment of soccer.

  Our Virtues

JOYWe are playing a game that evokes a sense of fun, childlikeness and freedom. The way we play our game should be a foreshadowing of and overflow from our relationship with Jesus. Our staff should be joy-filled and hope that people who encounter a staff would desire to have this joy that is within us.

        INTEGRITYWe want to have integrity in the game and around the game. We operate in the tension of professional excellence in a competitive environment while not idolizing performance as our identity.

        FAITHFULNESSWe are bound to the full Gospel which acknowledges sin as the true problem with the world while pointing to the extravagant love of God for sinful and broken humanity evident in the cross of Jesus Christ.

        COURAGEThe scope of where we strive to see Gospel change manifested is the whole world. We, with a courage stemming from the love of God, seek to reach the next player, family, community, city and country with the Gospel message through the global environment of competitive sport.

Los Orlando Eagles son una División de Missionary Athletes International (MAI). Hoy, MAI cuenta con 6 Divisiones en los Estados Unidos, ubicadas en: Orlando, Florida; el Sur de California; Charlotte, Carolina del Norte; High Point, Carolina del Norte; Chicago, Illinois; y Phoenix, Arizona, con programas ministeriales afiliados adicionales en otros estados y países alrededor del mundo.

  Missionary Athletes International tiene la pasión de compartir el mensaje de Jesucristo con personas de todo el mundo a través del deporte del fútbol. Dado que el fútbol es el deporte más popular del mundo, ¡más países pertenecen a la FIFA (la organización que rige la competencia internacional) que a las Naciones Unidas! Saca un balón de fútbol en casi cualquier lugar del mundo y atraerás a una multitud de niños. A través del disfrute común de este deporte mundial, podemos construir relaciones que nos permiten compartir el mensaje del amor redentor de Dios.
